summary: Forward Industries filed an 8-K disclosing a registered direct offering priced September 22, 2026, with an institutional investor for 3,125,000 common shares at $8.00 per share, roughly $25.0 million gross, closing September 24, 2026. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acted as exclusive placement agent, earning a 5% cash fee plus up to $50,000 accountable legal reimbursement. Shares were issued under an effective Form S-3ASR shelf. Net proceeds are earmarked for Solana purchases, working capital and general corporate purposes. The agreement imposes a 15-day lock-up on further issuance or registration filings. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and Solana treasury strategy.
